content: Muusaila-mulusad bergusad

Geb degine, Bab-Dummad Noéʼgi, degi, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmaladgi, ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemaladgi, bela ur-dummadyaba-bukwadgi binsaded. Bab-Dummad we-napneggi burwa ogornonikid. Geb degi, dii ilided.
Deginbali, demar-wilasailadgi dii-sailagan-mamaid atided, degine, nibneggi dii-sailagan-mamaid atidmogad. Dii bar wissulid.
Agine, dii binna-binna ilided. Iba-dulagugle-gakambe-gusgu (150), dii nue ilided.
Geb nii-walagugled-ibambe-gakagugledgi, ur-dummad Ararat-yalagangi megidapid.
Dii nue-iremai gualid. Nii-warambed-gebe-iba-onodedgi bato yar-dummagan-e-mullumar noalid.
Iba-dulabogwad-sorba (40), Noé ur-dummadgi yawagak-bipi-soblesad egasad.
Geb agi, sikwisichid barmisad. Sikwisichiddi gannar-gannar gukudii gusad, dii-dingued edarbedii gusad.
Noé sikwisichid-barmisad-sorba, nuu barmisad, adi, dakega sana napa dingudibeye.
Ar napa amba yoo dingusoggu, nuu siged amissurgusad. Degisoggu, gannar ur-dummadse nonikid. Noé e-argan onosgu, nuu-gasad, ur-dummadyaba gannar nuu-odosad.
Noé ibagugle (7) napi edarbisbalid, a-sorba gannar nuu barmisbalid.
Bato nue neg-mutikguali, nuu gannar nonikid. E-nugargi olivo-gagan senonikid. Agi, Noé nabir neg-nue-dingumaid mag daksad.
Noé amba ibagugle (7) napi edarbisbalid, geb agi, gannar Noé nuu barmisbalid. Agindi, nuu Noéʼse bar gannar nonisulid.
Degidgine, Noé birga-dulataled-ilanergwa-gakagwensak-nikadgi (601), napneg nue dingusad. Nii-gebe-gwisguded-ibagwenadgi, Noé ur-dummad-e-uas earisad. Geb agi dakded, napa dingusnai.
Nii-warbogwad-iba-dulagwen-gakagugledgi, napa nue-dingusad.
Geb degi, Bab-Dummad Noéʼga sogded:
“Ur-dummadyaba-be-gudiid be nodago. Be-ome, be-masmala, degi, be-balagan beba nodamarmogo.
Ibmar-dula-gudidimalad ur-dummadyaba-bukwad bela be onobalo:

content.text: Deginbali, dula ichesur mergumalaga, we-napneg-naidgi bela ambikumalagar.”

content: Geb agine, Noé, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad. Geb Noé bela ibmar-durgan-swilidikmalad, degi, nuumar-swilidikmalad akar-akar-ugakaase susad. Geb degine, ailagi ogumakar Bab-Jehováʼga uksad.

Ibmar-ogumakaled-yeer-yapanned Bab-Jehováʼse-mosgu, Bab-Jehová sogded: “We-napneg dulemar-isgued-ular, bar an ukabsaosulid. Ar dulemar gusgu na sapingwagwad-akar e-gwagegi unnila isguedginbi binsadimalad. Degine, an emi-imaksadyob, muusailaba bela ibmar-dula-gudidiid bar an ogilogosulid.

content.text: neg uere guoed, neg diopii guoed,
Bela wemar-ibmar nikagu guoed, sate guosulid.”
